commands.name: ugcportal dashboard
commands.description: Beads, PRs and agent status for ugcportal: live HTML dashboard, a Claude terminal and the refresh loop

surfaces.name: Refresh
surfaces.command: if command -v npx >/dev/null || { newest="$(printf '%s\n' "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; [ -d "$newest" ] && PATH="$newest:$PATH"; }; then sh scripts/dashboard.sh github:eiriksf-capgemini/bead-dashboard#26549cef52cd07c1d22cdde57d811af8aecaf351; U="$(sh scripts/dashboard.sh github:eiriksf-capgemini/bead-dashboard#26549cef52cd07c1d22cdde57d811af8aecaf351 --print-url)"; for S in $(cmux tree --workspace "$CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID" | grep "\[browser\]" | grep -o "surface:[0-9]*"); do cmux browser --surface "$S" navigate "$U" >/dev/null; done; sh scripts/dashboard.sh github:eiriksf-capgemini/bead-dashboard#26549cef52cd07c1d22cdde57d811af8aecaf351 --watch 30 --sidebar; else echo "bead-dashboard: npx is not on PATH and no nvm install was found under $HOME/.nvm/versions/node" >&2; (exit 127); fi; exec ${SHELL:-/bin/zsh} -l
